one_line: A 7th–8th century Pallava merchant-envoy traveling between Mamallapuram, Nagapattinam, Sri Lanka and Tang China.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly weathered from sea travel
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jawline, calm observant eyes with a thoughtful, diplomatic default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted slightly to the side, gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth; topped with a simple pale-cream cloth turban wrapped narrow and close to the skull, with a small red band at the base
appearance.costume: he wears a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with long, slightly fitted sleeves and a simple round neckline, the hem and cuffs edged with a thin maroon border; over this is a draped, shoulder-to-hip angavastra of soft cotton in deep maroon with a narrow gold stripe along the edges, worn over the left shoulder and across the chest; his lower garment is a ankle-length dhoti in muted sand-brown, wrapped neatly and pleated at the front, with a darker brown border; simple brown leather sandals on his feet; on his wrists are two thin gold bangles, a small palm-leaf manuscript pouch tied at his waist cord on the right, and a modest wooden-bead necklace indicating piety and travel among Buddhist sites; overall textiles look practical and travel-worn, but clean and orderly, suited to a maritime envoy moving between ports and courts.
appearance.signature: a rolled-up palm-leaf diplomatic letter case bundled in a slender reddish-brown wooden tube with carved bands, carried in his left hand as the symbol of his role in trade and diplomatic missions

ref_desc: A mid-30s Pallava envoy with medium-brown skin, low-knotted black hair under a cream turban, off-white long-sleeved tunic, maroon angavastra, sand-brown dhoti, simple sandals, modest jewellery, and a reddish-brown palm-leaf letter tube, using maroon, off-white and sand-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a 7th–8th century Pallava merchant-envoy from Mamallapuram: a mid-30s South Indian man with medium-brown complexion, oval face, neat moustache and short jawline beard, and calm observant eyes. His thick black hair is parted, smoothed, and gathered into a low knot at the back, covered by a narrow pale-cream cloth turban wrapped close to the head with a slim red band at its base. He wears an ankle-length sand-brown dhoti, wrapped and pleated in front with a slightly darker brown border, and an off-white cotton tunic that reaches just above the knees, long-sleeved, with a round neckline and thin maroon edging at the cuffs and hem. Draped over his left shoulder and across his chest is a deep maroon angavastra of soft cotton, with a narrow gold stripe along all edges, falling to mid-thigh. Simple brown leather sandals are on his feet. He has two thin gold bangles on his wrists and a modest wooden-bead necklace. At his waist cord on the right hangs a small pouch for palm-leaf documents. In his left hand he prominently carries his signature item: a rolled palm-leaf diplomatic letter case held within a slender reddish-brown wooden tube carved with simple horizontal bands. Use a palette dominated by off-white, deep maroon, sand-brown, dark brown and touches of gold, and present him front-facing in a neutral stance so every detail of face, hair, clothing and the letter tube is clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
